scenes.title: Location and an ambiguous intent
scenes.caption: S3 is dataset entry edge_003 (ground truth: QoD). L3 only checks that the chosen service is published, so a wrong-but-registered choice still executes: the validator guarantees well-formed calls, not intent correctness.

scenes.title: Switching LLM backends at runtime
scenes.caption: POST /config/provider switches GPT-4o-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash without a restart; all three produce the same CAMARA payload. Planning time differs per provider.

runs.output:

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001    2.6 s   qod  qosProfile=QOS_E_STREAMING  duration=1800  appServer=198.51.100.10  device=+90532•••••67
gemini-2.5-flash             7.8 s   qod  qosProfile=QOS_E_STREAMING  duration=1800  appServer=198.51.100.10  device=+90532•••••67

scenes.title: Which layer catches what?
scenes.caption: Faults are injected into correct plans. Each is caught by its target layer; the LLM feedback loop repairs L1/L2 payload faults in one iteration but cannot repair a service-level (L3) fault.

runs.output:
Faults injected into correct plans; live L3; real LLM feedback loop (max 3 iterations)

layer fault             caught  repaired  iters  feedback
L1    missing_field        2/2       2/2    1.0     1.6 s
L1    wrong_type           2/2       2/2    1.0     1.4 s
L2    bad_e164             2/2       2/2    1.0     1.5 s
L2    duration_policy      2/2       2/2    1.0     1.2 s
L2    unknown_profile      2/2       2/2    1.0     1.5 s
L2    bad_ipv4             2/2       2/2    1.0     1.4 s
L3    unpublished          2/2       0/2    3.0     4.5 s

scenes.title: Scalability and the external LLM API
scenes.tag: Reviewer 2: latency breakdown, scalability, LLM dependency
scenes.caption: Without the LLM the platform serves well over 100 req/s with live L3 checks; with GPT-4o-mini the latency stays at about 2.6 s while throughput scales with concurrency: the LLM API is the bottleneck.

scenes.title: Evaluation, ablations and repository consistency
scenes.caption: 300 unique intents. The keyword rules were written for the 60-entry pilot (archived), hence 60/60 there and 190/240 on held-out intents. Without schema grounding GPT-4o-mini drops to 16.3%.
